standard_format_name: Key Facts Statement (KFS) for Retail and MSME Term Loans
purpose: Official benchmark/answer key for simplified loan terms disclosure

1_loan_sanctioned_amount.definition: Net amount approved for the borrower
1_loan_sanctioned_amount.plain_explanation: The exact total money the bank agreed to loan you.

2_disbursement_schedule.plain_explanation: When and how the funds will hit your bank account.

3_loan_tenure.definition: Period of the loan in months/years
3_loan_tenure.plain_explanation: Total number of months you have to pay back the loan.

5_interest_rate_and_type.plain_explanation: Whether your rate is fixed or can change when central bank repo rates move.

6_annual_percentage_rate_apr.definition: All-inclusive annual cost of credit (Interest + Processing + Insurance + Admin)
6_annual_percentage_rate_apr.plain_explanation: The real, all-in percentage cost of your loan per year.

7_contingent_penal_charges.definition: Late fees and bounce charges (must be simple, non-capitalized)
7_contingent_penal_charges.plain_explanation: Extra fees charged if you pay late. Note: RBI bans compounding interest on penalties.

8_foreclosure_and_prepayment_charges.definition: Charges for paying early (0% for individual floating loans)
8_foreclosure_and_prepayment_charges.plain_explanation: Fees for paying off the loan early. Zero penalty if you are an individual on a floating rate.

9_cooling_off_look_up_period.definition: Window to cancel without penalty (typically 3-7 days)
9_cooling_off_look_up_period.plain_explanation: Grace window to change your mind and exit the loan without penalty.

10_grievance_redressal_details.definition: Nodal officer and Banking Ombudsman contact info
10_grievance_redressal_details.plain_explanation: Where you can report unfair bank practices or file regulatory complaints.

red_flag_warnings: Unilateral rate change clause without prior consent
Personal guarantee exposing director's private residential assets
Immediate acceleration within 7 days upon technical default
